review_scope: Reviewed the entire authorized C..H diff: three files, 848 additions, zero deletions. Exact H is not approved because one P2 manifestation of schema_overrestriction1 remains open.

evidence.requirement: The frozen r6 schema requires nonempty string targetId and configurationName. It does not restrict either field to whitespace-free tokens.
manifestations: A valid Local configuration with targetId="Target West" is rejected by Test-PxText through ConvertTo-PxConfig line 230.
A valid Remote configuration with configurationName="Endpoint West" is rejected by the same predicate through line 238.
evidence.mechanism: The shared predicate rejects every whitespace character through its \s branch, including ordinary internal spaces in otherwise nonempty text.
evidence.measurement: An independently executed in-memory source-predicate probe rejected "Target West", "Endpoint West" and "Mục tiêu", while accepting "tgt-one" and "Cấu.Hình". This was source-predicate verification, not native PowerShell execution.
evidence.test_contract_mismatch: A2-04 explicitly classifies targetId="bad id" as invalid; A2-06 line 357 classifies configurationName="a b" as invalid. A4-01 also relies on a space-containing targetId being invalid. Consequently, the retained green harness enforces this extra restriction.

remedy.where: Test-PxText and its two callers; the corresponding A2-04, A2-06 and A4-01 fixtures.
remedy.approach: Remove the unsupported token restriction for both text fields, retain schema type and empty-value validation, and return accepted values unchanged. Replace space-containing negative fixtures with positive preservation cases. Give the redaction fixture an actually invalid schema value so it continues testing error sanitization.
remedy.regression_risks: Trimming or normalizing names could silently select a different target. Changing the shared validator without updating all three fixture locations could also weaken redaction coverage or preserve contradictory assertions.

findings.closure_probe: On native PS5.1 and PS7, accept and exactly preserve internal-space values in targetId for Local and Remote configurations and in Remote configurationName, including Unicode text. Retain empty/wrong-type rejection, Unicode/long-name regressions and secret-error checks. A focused mutant restoring the whitespace-free predicate must fail these new positive cases.
